question: 一笔缴款从缴款人缴款开始，到资金最终缴入国库，中间要依次经过哪些环节？
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `fiscal_collection`.`fpaycode`) `fiscal_collection_view__paybook_count`, count(*) `fiscal_collection_view__count`, sum(`fiscal_collection`.`famt`) `fiscal_collection_view__amt`, sum(CASE WHEN (`fiscal_collection`.`freceiveddate` != '') THEN `fiscal_collection`.`fimamt` END) `fiscal_collection_view__entered_amt` 
FROM  (SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT * FROM (
      SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT t.*, c.chg_agency_name_canon FROM fne_paybook_full_high t
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT fchgagencode,
                          arrayStringConcat(arraySort(groupUniqArray(fchgagenname)), ' / ') AS chg_agency_name_canon
                   FROM fne_paybook_full_high GROUP BY fchgagencode) c ON t.fchgagencode = c.fchgagencode
      ) x1
      LEFT JOIN (SELECT frecrgncode,
                        arrayStringConcat(arraySort(groupUniqArray(frecrgnname)), ' / ') AS rec_rgn_name_canon
                 FROM fne_paybook_full_high WHERE frecrgncode != '' GROUP BY frecrgncode) r ON x1.frecrgncode = r.frecrgncode
    ) x2
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT fitemcode,
                      arrayStringConcat(arraySort(groupUniqArray(fitemname)), ' / ') AS item_name_canon
               FROM fne_paybook_full_high WHERE fitemcode != '' GROUP BY fitemcode) i ON x2.fitemcode = i.fitemcode
  ) x3
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT fsubcode,
                    arrayStringConcat(arraySort(groupUniqArray(fsubname)), ' / ') AS sub_name_canon
             FROM fne_paybook_full_high WHERE fsubcode != '' GROUP BY fsubcode) s ON x3.fsubcode = s.fsubcode
) x4
LEFT JOIN (SELECT frecsubcode,
                  arrayStringConcat(arraySort(groupUniqArray(frecsubname)), ' / ') AS rec_sub_name_canon
           FROM fne_paybook_full_high WHERE frecsubcode != '' GROUP BY frecsubcode) rs ON x4.frecsubcode = rs.frecsubcode
)  AS `fiscal_collection`
LIMIT 10
answer: 环节链路（依据 meta ai_context，非臆测）：① 开票——执收单位开具缴款书（fill_date）；② 缴款——缴款人按缴款书缴款（pay_date，直缴/汇缴）；③ 缴款确认——确认环节（confirm_date，实测与缴款日几乎同日；缴款书状态 fstate 置 3=已缴款确认，当前 975 笔中 965 笔已确认）；④ 资金到账/对账——资金到账（received_date）与缴款书对账（reconcile_date），meta 明示两者无严格先后（有已对账未到账、也有已到账未对账）；资金管理方式由 bgt_style 区分（1 国库/2 专户/4 其他），需缴库的资金进入缴库环节——财政开具缴库单（build_date 建单，缴库单科目为清分归属口径）；⑤ 缴库回执→入国库——缴库回执成功（status='9'）后资金入国库（enter_status='1'，入国库日期 enter_date），之后到账对账（reconcile_status='1'）。全期实测：缴款书 975 笔/明细 1281 行/缴款金额 183.3 亿，到账金额 2935.4 万；缴库单 70 张/缴库明细 76 行/缴库金额 2945.6 万，其中已入国库 26 笔/4.63 万元。口径声明：缴款侧与缴库侧是两个视图、科目口径两侧不可混用；已入国库时间轴用 enter_date 而非 build_date；到账金额 entered_amt 为 fisenter 可用性修正后口径（2026-10-09 拍板）。数据范围：全库全期，无时间过滤；最后一表 hitPreAgg=true。
